verses.text_urhobo: Ọnana ọbe rẹ uvwiẹ rẹ Adam. Vwẹ ọke rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwọ ma ohwo, ọ da ma vwẹ uhoho rẹ Ọghẹnẹ
verses.text_romanized: onana obe re uvwie re adam vwe oke re oghene vwo ma ohwo o da ma vwe uhoho re oghene

verses.text_urhobo: Ọshare vẹ aye ọ ma ayen, o de bruphihọ kẹ ayen, o de se odẹ rayen ohwo vwẹ ọke rọ vwọ ma ayen nu.
verses.text_romanized: oshare ve aye o ma ayen o de bruphiho ke ayen o de se ode rayen ohwo vwe oke ro vwo ma ayen nu

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Adam vwọ dia ikpe ujosa gbẹ ihwe nu, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ rẹ ọmọ ro vwiẹri họhọ oma rọye, kọye uhoho rọye, o de se ode rọye Sẹt.
verses.text_romanized: oke re adam vwo dia ikpe ujosa gbe ihwe nu o da rhe dia ose re omo ro vwieri hoho oma roye koye uhoho roye o de se ode roye set

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ re Adam vwẹ ọke ro vwo vwiẹ Sẹt nu da dia ikpe uri ẹne, o de ji vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa
verses.text_romanized: ede re akpo re adam vwe oke ro vwo vwie set nu da dia ikpe uri ene o de ji vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ rẹ Adam ejobi da dia ikpe uri ẹne gbe ujosa gbẹ ihwe; o ki rhi ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo re adam ejobi da dia ikpe uri ene gbe ujosa gbe ihwe o ki rhi ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Sẹt rhe vwọ dia ikpe ujọne gbẹ iyori nure, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Inọsh.
verses.text_romanized: ri set rhe vwo dia ikpe ujone gbe iyori nure o da rhe dia ose ri inosh

verses.text_urhobo: Sẹt vwo vwiẹ Inosh nu ọ da rhe dia akpọ na ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ighwrẹ, o de vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: set vwo vwie inosh nu o da rhe dia akpo na ikpe uri ene gbe ighwre o de vwie emeshare kugbe emete

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ ri Sẹt dia akpọ na ejobi da dia uri ẹne gbẹ ujosa gbẹ ihwivẹ, o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede ri set dia akpo na ejobi da dia uri ene gbe ujosa gbe ihwive o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Inọsh vwọ dia akpọ ikpe ujọne gbe ihwe re ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Kenan.
verses.text_romanized: ri inosh vwo dia akpo ikpe ujone gbe ihwe re o da rhe dia ose ri kenan

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ Inọsh rhi vwo vwiẹ Kenan nu ọ da dia akpọ ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ihwiori, o de rhe vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa.
verses.text_romanized: re inosh rhi vwo vwie kenan nu o da dia akpo ikpe uri ene gbe ihwiori o de rhe vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ rẹ Inọsh ejobi da dia ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ iyori; o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo re inosh ejobi da dia ikpe uri ene gbe iyori o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Kenan vwọ dia ikpe ujorha gbẹ ihwe nure, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Mahalalẹl.
verses.text_romanized: ri kenan vwo dia ikpe ujorha gbe ihwe nure o da rhe dia ose ri mahalalel

verses.text_urhobo: Kenan rhi vwo vwiẹ Mahalalẹl nu, ọke rhe dia akpọ na ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ujuvẹ, o ki rhe vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: kenan rhi vwo vwie mahalalel nu oke rhe dia akpo na ikpe uri ene gbe ujuve o ki rhe vwie emeshare kugbe emete

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Kenan ejobi da dia ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ujori gbẹ ihwe; o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo ri kenan ejobi da dia ikpe uri ene gbe ujori gbe ihwe o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Mahalalẹl vwọ dia akpọ ikpe ujorha gbe iyori nu, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Jared.
verses.text_romanized: ri mahalalel vwo dia akpo ikpe ujorha gbe iyori nu o da rhe dia ose ri jared

verses.text_urhobo: Mahalalẹl rhi vwo vwiẹ Jared nu ọ da dia akpọ na ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ọgban, o de vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa.
verses.text_romanized: mahalalel rhi vwo vwie jared nu o da dia akpo na ikpe uri ene gbe ogban o de vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Mahalalẹl ejobi da dia ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ujọne gbẹ ihwe gbẹ iyori, o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo ri mahalalel ejobi da dia ikpe uri ene gbe ujone gbe ihwe gbe iyori o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Jared vwọ dia akpọ na ikpe ujọrenre gbe ivẹ nure ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ rẹ Inọk.
verses.text_romanized: oke ri jared vwo dia akpo na ikpe ujorenre gbe ive nure o da rhe dia ose re inok

verses.text_urhobo: Jared rhi vwo vwiẹ Inọk nu, ọ da dia akpọ na ikpe uri ẹne, o de rhi vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa.
verses.text_romanized: jared rhi vwo vwie inok nu o da dia akpo na ikpe uri ene o de rhi vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Jared ejobi da dia uri ẹne gbẹ ujọrenre gbẹ ivẹ, o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo ri jared ejobi da dia uri ene gbe ujorenre gbe ive o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Inọk vwọ dia akpọ ikpe ujorha gbe iyori nu, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Metusela.
verses.text_romanized: ri inok vwo dia akpo ikpe ujorha gbe iyori nu o da rhe dia ose ri metusela

verses.text_urhobo: Inọk da yan nene Ọghẹnẹ ro vwo vwiẹ Metusela nu ikpe uri gbe ujori o de vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa
verses.text_romanized: inok da yan nene oghene ro vwo vwie metusela nu ikpe uri gbe ujori o de vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ rẹ Inọk ejobi da dia uri gbe ujorenre gbe iyori.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo re inok ejobi da dia uri gbe ujorenre gbe iyori

verses.text_urhobo: Inọk da yan nene Ọghẹnẹ o gbi ghwu-u, fikiridie Ọghẹnẹ reyerọ.
verses.text_romanized: inok da yan nene oghene o gbi ghwu u fikiridie oghene reyero

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Metusela vwọ dia akpọ ikpe ujurhiri gbe ighwrẹ re, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Lamẹk.
verses.text_romanized: oke ri metusela vwo dia akpo ikpe ujurhiri gbe ighwre re o da rhe dia ose ri lamek

verses.text_urhobo: Metusela rhi vwo vwiẹ Lamẹk nu, ọ da dia ikpe uri erha gbẹ ujurhiri gbẹ ivẹ, o de vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ efa.
verses.text_romanized: metusela rhi vwo vwie lamek nu o da dia ikpe uri erha gbe ujurhiri gbe ive o de vwie emeshare kugbe emete efa

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Metusela ejobi da dia ikpe uri ẹne gbẹ ujọrenre gbẹ irhiri, o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo ri metusela ejobi da dia ikpe uri ene gbe ujorenre gbe irhiri o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Re Lamẹk vwọ dia akpọ ikpe ujurhiri gbẹ ivẹ nure, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ rẹ ọmọshare,
verses.text_romanized: re lamek vwo dia akpo ikpe ujurhiri gbe ive nure o da rhe dia ose re omoshare

verses.text_urhobo: o de se odẹ rọye Noa, tanẹ, Vwẹ evun rẹ otọ rẹ Ọrovwohwo harhere na ọye Ọnana che nurhe rhe kẹ avwanre omaerovwo nẹ iruo vẹ owian rẹ abọ rẹ avwanre.
verses.text_romanized: o de se ode roye noa tane vwe evun re oto re orovwohwo harhere na oye onana che nurhe rhe ke avwanre omaerovwo ne iruo ve owian re abo re avwanre

verses.text_urhobo: Lamẹk rhi vwo vwiẹ Noa nu, ọ da dia akpọ ikpe uri ivẹ gbẹ ujurhiri gbẹ ihwiori, o de vwiẹ emeshare kugbe emetẹ.
verses.text_romanized: lamek rhi vwo vwie noa nu o da dia akpo ikpe uri ive gbe ujurhiri gbe ihwiori o de vwie emeshare kugbe emete

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye ẹdẹ rẹ akpọ ri Lamẹk ejobi da dia ikpe uri erha gbẹ ujori gbẹ ighwrẹ, o de ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye ede re akpo ri lamek ejobi da dia ikpe uri erha gbe ujori gbe ighwre o de ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Noa vwọ ikpe uri ivẹ gbẹ ujori, ọ da rhe dia ọsẹ ri Shẹm, Ham kugbe Jafẹt.
verses.text_romanized: ri noa vwo ikpe uri ive gbe ujori o da rhe dia ose ri shem ham kugbe jafet
